checkins._purpose: Event-anchored reminders to check in on each other, attached to occasions already on this page - NOT a fixed daily schedule.
checkins.name: Check-in
checkins.name_note: 'Check-in' is chosen: the plainest of the two. 'Us time' is the alternative. No jargon.

anchor.explanation: The 22nd is the day-of-month of the 'started chatting' milestone; the 1st is the start of the month. Together that is roughly fortnightly, plus the three milestone anniversaries already listed on the page.

checkins.effective_frequency: roughly weekly-to-fortnightly (1st and 22nd), plus the three milestone anniversaries

prompts.text: Name one thing your partner did well this week, and tell them - not just think it.
Ask how your partner is really doing, then listen before you answer.
Thank your partner for one specific thing they did, rather than a general 'thanks'.
Check in on how your partner is feeling about the week, and name what they do well for you.

unsupported: OWNER CONFIRMATION: the prompts above are warm but generic. If you want them to name specific things (a pet, a shared joke, a nickname), tell me the words and I will put them in - I will not invent details about your partner.
